card.name: Words just before given or administered
card.fires_on: Small words right before a verb of giving, such as given or administered, after a drug name or dose. Examples are was, if, of, orally, co and be.

modes.label: Passive before given
modes.description: A drug name plus was, or should be, just before given or administered in animal or dosing text.

modes.label: Other link words
modes.description: Words like if or of where a form of give is expected next.
modes.example: LEUCOVORIN MAY BE HARMFUL OR FATAL<< IF>> GIVEN INTRATHECALLY.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward writing give, giving or given next.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a drug is said to be given or administered.
